c59199db45e30e3e.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Senior Operator, Main Pulpit, to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position involves leading and controlling the hot rolling mill line from a centralized main pulpit, ensuring coordinated operations and product quality. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Position Summary The Senior Operator will be responsible for overseeing the hot rolling mill line, maintaining tension control, managing rolling parameters, and ensuring production pace. This role requires close coordination with downstream and upstream areas to ensure product dimensional compliance. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor the entire rolling mill line, including roughing, intermediate, finishing, and quenching sections, using HMI/SCADA systems. Coordinate the timing and synchronization of rolling stands, pinch rolls, flying shear, and cooling bed movement. Adjust inter-stand tension and rolling speed to maintain consistent product shape and prevent cobbles. Monitor loopers, motor loads, and inter-stand gaps to ensure smooth rolling flow. Control flying shear operations according to bar cut-length requirements and adjust parameters for bar counting, cold shear timing, and reject diversion. Monitor product section, pass-line stability, and rib alignment using display cameras and feedback systems. Communicate with furnace, roller, and cooling bed operators to manage billet delivery, downtime, and pass change-over. Log production events, delays, and cobbles in shift report records. Ensure heat number marking (automated/manual) is synchronized with billet flow and verify prompt action on dimensional and rib inspection alerts. Follow safety procedures for emergency stop, manual override, and interlocking systems, and initiate safe shutdown during abnormal situations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a similar operational role within a hot rolling mill environment. Demonstrated ability to operate and control complex mill lines from a centralized pulpit. Strong understanding of HMI/SCADA systems for mill line operation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, requiring on-site presence to manage mill operations effectively. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply.

c5c3412419043497.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب فايد للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ الأعمال المساحية المكتبية والميدانية، ويشمل مجالات متعددة مثل المساحات الجيوديسية والطبوغرافية والاستشعار عن بعد والمسح البحري. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال هندسة المساحة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المسح اللازمة لمشاريع الأبنية والطرق وغيرها. رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية بدقة. متابعة التنفيذ الميداني ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية للمشاريع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال المساحية وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة. إجراء الدراسات الاستطلاعية وإعداد شبكات المساحة المثلثية. الإشراف على تثبيت نقاط الاستناد المرجعية للمشاريع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال هندسة المساحة. فهم قوي لمبادئ المساحة الجيوديسية والطبوغرافية. القدرة على استخدام تقنيات الاستشعار عن بعد والمسح البحري. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس المساحة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مكتب فايد للاستشارات الهندسية في المدينة المنورة. يشمل الدور مهام مكتبية وميدانية تتطلب التواجد في مواقع المشاريع المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية.

c52f10d54e880afa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب تقويم أسنان ووجه وفكين للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان التي تتطلب عمليات وأجهزة تقويم، بالإضافة إلى متابعة الحالات وإعداد الخطط العلاجية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المريض وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة لتحليلها وتشخيص حالات الفك والأسنان. إعداد خطط التقويم والعلاج وبرامجها الزمنية، ومتابعة تجهيز وتركيب أجهزة التقويم السنية وتثبيتها. معالجة التهابات اللثة وإجراء جراحات تقويم الفكين الصغرى، ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. فحص الأسنان والوجه والفكين لتشخيص الأمراض ومعالجة التشوهات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال طب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين. متابعة جميع أفراد الأسرة وملاحظة أمراض الأسنان والوجه والفكين الوراثية والعمل على الوقاية منها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها، وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين الصحة العامة للأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال طب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارات في إعداد الخطط العلاجية وتنفيذ المعالجات السنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيصية وعلاجية قوية. القدرة على التعامل مع المرضى من جميع الفئات العمرية. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والأخلاقية في ممارسة طب الأسنان. مهارات التواصل الفعال مع المرضى والزملاء. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب تقويم الأسنان والوجه والفكين ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في عيادات صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان بمدينة مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

c541e78b3b09b1a0.description: About Eaton and the Opportunity Eaton is a global leader focused on energy-efficient solutions. The company is committed to equality and inclusivity, aiming to empower customers to manage electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical energy effectively, safely, and sustainably. Eaton is dedicated to enhancing quality of life and protecting the environment through innovative energy management technologies and services. The company is on a growth trajectory, aiming to double sales across EMEA by 2030. Role Overview: Mega Projects Specification Sales Manager The Mega Projects Specification Sales Manager will be responsible for developing, managing, promoting, and expanding Eaton’s network within an assigned region. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, involves selling LV switchgear and Busway systems in Commercial & Infrastructure segments through authorized partners. The role focuses on early project identification and positioning Eaton’s solutions in large or serialized large projects, requiring strong coordination with internal stakeholders for effective project follow-up, opportunity management, and successful execution. A minimum of 5-10 years of experience is required for this role. Key Responsibilities Identify, qualify, and develop new project opportunities within the region. Establish and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at engineering firms, consultants, and contractors. Conduct discovery meetings to understand project requirements and develop initial solution concepts. Influence project stakeholders to align with Eaton’s portfolio and value proposition. Transfer project concepts and requirements to internal technical and support teams. Make informed bid/no-bid recommendations based on project scope and strategic fit. Maintain accurate and timely project information in Salesforce. Conduct regular customer meetings and lead business review sessions. Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve regional targets and business growth. Manage the opportunities pipeline, including quotations and follow-up activities to secure deals. Support the standardization and optimization of project engagement processes. Analyze lost opportunities and identify improvement actions. Promote continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen project engagement effectiveness. Work Environment and Culture Eaton offers a professional working environment where safety and ethics are prioritized. The company's culture and values define its operations, emphasizing that the way business is conducted is as important as the products created. Eaton invests in its employees through ongoing learning and development opportunities, provided via Eaton University, supporting long-term growth beyond salary and benefits. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Mega Projects Specification Sales Manager position in Riyadh are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c5fcec419ab85b51.description: About the Role Alu masa factory *** metal product is seeking an experienced and well-organized Store Manager to oversee warehouse operations in Al Jubail. This full-time role involves managing inventory, material receiving, storage, and issuance for projects involving aluminum, glass, steel, and architectural façades. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in construction or manufacturing warehouse operations and excellent inventory control skills. Key Responsibilities Manage daily warehouse operations, ensuring proper organization, cleanliness, and material safety. Supervise material receiving, inspection, storage, issuance, and dispatch processes. Maintain accurate inventory records, stock registers, and material tracking systems. Handle various materials including aluminum profiles, ACP sheets, glass, steel sections, stainless steel materials, hardware, accessories, and consumables. Verify incoming materials against Purchase Orders (PO), Delivery Notes (DN), and approved specifications. Prepare and maintain Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), Material Issue Vouchers (MIV), and Material Return Notes (MRN). Monitor stock levels and coordinate with procurement for timely material replenishment. Implement material identification, labeling, tagging, and proper storage procedures. Maintain project-wise material allocation, consumption, and balance records. Coordinate with production and site teams for timely material issuance and dispatch. Monitor material wastage, damage, shortages, and surplus stock. Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile inventory discrepancies. Maintain records of tools, equipment, machinery accessories, and consumables. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reports. Ensure compliance with warehouse safety requirements and 5S practices. Supervise warehouse staff and material handling activities. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in warehouse operations. Strong experience in construction or manufacturing warehouse environments. Demonstrated ability in inventory control and material management. Proficiency in coordinating with procurement, production, and project teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, focusing on warehouse operations for metal products and architectural façade projects.

c5149c96c62fdb4f.description: About the Role Vanderlande is seeking a Site Mechanical Supervisor BHS Eng to oversee the installation of mechanical equipment for material handling projects. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves leading and guiding an installation team, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards, and contributing to project success from installation through handover. Key Responsibilities Organize and supervise the installation of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for Vanderlande material handling projects, aligning with project schedules. Provide clear instructions to the onsite installation team, ensuring all work complies with quality standards and Vanderlande processes. Promote a culture of safety among the installation team throughout project execution. Conduct surveys of installation areas, verify readiness, and confirm required facilities for installation. Support site handover processes. Maintain a strong onsite presence through regular site walks and a thorough auditing schedule, focusing on safety and quality control in line with Vanderlande standards. Contribute to the creation of the project installation schedule and ensure adherence to meet project timelines. Monitor team progress, identify improvement opportunities, and support continuous enhancement efforts. Report regularly on work progress to the Site Manager, ensuring effective coordination with subcontractors and stakeholders. Train new technicians to enhance their skills, fostering ongoing team improvement and promoting continuous learning. Organize and facilitate all support activities to ensure a smooth commissioning and testing process until handover to the customer. Core Activities and Deliverables The supervisor is directly responsible for performing mechanical installation and mechanical static inspections. Key deliverables include As-Built Notes & Drawings and a Defect List. Consultation is required for activities such as commissioning conveying systems, commissioning safety span of control, creating installation spare parts (ME), developing the site management plan, making EM documentation as-built, and pre-commissioning conveying cabinets, safety systems, and safety PLC cabinets. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in mechanical supervision, particularly within material handling projects. The role requires a strong understanding of mechanical and electromechanical equipment installation, quality standards, and safety protocols. Work Environment and Travel This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering projects in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves significant onsite presence. Travel to project sites is required as necessary for project execution and support, with travel requirements varying based on project needs and locations.

c54de6b66a8807de.description: مدير/ة العمليات واللوجستيات والمالية – استيراد وتصدير جدة | دوام كامل من مقر الشركة نبحث عن قائد عملي لإدارة العمليات اليومية لشركة استيراد وتصدير، يجمع بين الخبرة التشغيلية واللوجستية والمعرفة المحاسبية والضريبية. المهام الرئيسية • إدارة دورة الاستيراد والتصدير من طلب الشراء حتى التسليم. • التنسيق مع الموردين وشركات الشحن والتخليص الجمركي والمستودعات. • متابعة مستندات الشحن، سابر، HS Codes، المخزون والتكلفة الواصلة لكل شحنة. • متابعة الفواتير والمدفوعات والتحصيل والتسويات البنكية وحسابات الموردين والعملاء. • متابعة ضريبة القيمة المضافة والفوترة الإلكترونية ومتطلبات هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك. • إعداد التقارير التشغيلية والمالية ومؤشرات الأداء وقيادة فريق العمل. المتطلبات • بكالوريوس في المحاسبة أو المالية أو سلاسل الإمداد أو تخصص ذي صلة. • خبرة 5 سنوات أو أكثر في العمليات أو اللوجستيات أو المحاسبة، ويفضل داخل شركة استيراد وتصدير أو تجارة أو توزيع. • معرفة جيدة بالمحاسبة والمخزون والتكاليف وVAT وZATCA. • إجادة Excel ويفضل خبرة في أنظمة ERP. • شخصية قيادية، تنظيم قوي، وحل فعال للمشكلات. • العربية بطلاقة وإنجليزية عملية، مع الاستعداد للعمل من مقر الشركة في جدة. يفضل: عضوية SOCPA أو شهادة VAT، ومعرفة SABER وIncoterms. — English — Operations, Logistics & Finance Manager – Import & Export Jeddah | Full-time, on-site We are seeking a hands-on leader to manage the daily operations of an import and export business, combining strong logistics experience with accounting and tax knowledge. Preferred: SOCPA membership or VAT certification, plus knowledge of SABER and Incoterms.

c59ecc7621c152f6.description: A leading company in Real Estate Development and Construction of mega projects, is looking for an Office Manager for the Deputy CEO to work in our head office in Riyadh city. Key Responsibilities: Manage the Deputy CEO's calendar, meetings, travel, and correspondence, prioritizing competing demands. Act as the primary point of contact between the Deputy CEO's office and internal departments, external stakeholders, contractors, and government entities. Prepare, review, and edit reports, presentations, minutes of meetings, and official correspondence (English/Arabic). Track action items and follow up on deliverables across departments on behalf of the Deputy CEO. Coordinate high-level meetings, site visits, and events, including logistics and briefing materials. Manage office budget, supplies, and vendor coordination for the executive office. Supervise administrative/support staff within the office, if applicable. Support ad hoc strategic initiatives and special projects as assigned by the Deputy CEO. Skills & Competencies: Fluent English (spoken and written); Arabic fluency highly preferred/required. Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication. High discretion and professionalism handling confidential matters. Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with document/PMO systems a plus. Strong stakeholder management across executive, technical, and government levels. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced project environment.

c5a7e4c331edb307.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to join their team in Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves planning and supervising all maintenance activities for electrical equipment within the plant, working under the direction of the Section Head. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Assign preventive and corrective maintenance jobs as directed by the Section Head. Supervise and coordinate the activities of maintenance staff. Maintain records, prepare reports, and compose correspondence related to work. Execute work orders through CMMS (SAP) and coordinate with the planning engineer for job completion and technical matters. Ensure necessary communications and relations are maintained to report on status and ensure corrective actions are undertaken. Assist the Maintenance Manager in executing corrective and planned maintenance in line with the annual scheduled maintenance plan. Perform technical evaluation of quotations from the purchase department and recommend appropriate choices. Prepare purchase requisitions for spare parts and consumables, ensuring budgetary constraints and strategic spares availability. Review and recommend new maintenance procedures and work instructions. Supervise, direct, and coordinate the activities of all personnel assigned to the area. Ensure Environmental Aspect-Impact and Hazard Risk Assessments are carried out, controlled, and updated. Implement, monitor, and report IMS objectives, targets, and programs. Provide necessary resources for effective implementation and sustenance of IMS. Report IMS performance to management periodically. Ensure legal, contractual, and organizational compliance within the scope of activities. Identify root causes for non-conformances/deviations and implement corrective/preventive actions. Identify competency gaps for subordinate personnel and implement necessary actions. Carry out annual performance evaluations of reporting employees. Provide on-the-job training to new employees and evaluate their OJT performance. Identify, document, and control hazards in the assigned work area. Ensure identified aspects are monitored and operational controls are followed. Report deviations in the Integrated Management System, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Report emergencies, incidents, and near misses. Ensure effective resource utilization. Perform other duties as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within a plant maintenance environment. Proficiency in using CMMS (SAP) for work order execution and coordination. Strong understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance principles. Ability to perform technical evaluations and manage procurement processes for spare parts. c5bd69277ddf3e8d.description: About the Role moomoo is seeking a Graphic Designer to join its marketing team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. Design key visuals, campaign identities, social media posts, carousels, infographics, banners, and promotional materials for various platforms including X, Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. c546f2f8cb64284d.description: The FP&A Manager for Operating Assets will be responsible for management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, analysis, and performance monitoring of some of Qiddiya’s operating assets, including theme parks, hotels, golf courses, and sports venues. This role serves as a bridge between the FP&A department, the Finance Business Partner function, and the Asset Management/Operating Assets teams, working closely with FBPs to provide decision support, performance insights, and strategic financial recommendations. Essential duties and responsibilities: Lead the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial plans for operating assets in collaboration with FBPs and Asset Management Support scenario planning for pre-opening, ramp-up, and stabilization phases of assets Track and analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts, providing variance analysis and actionable insights to FBPs, asset managers, and leadership Develop dashboards and performance reports in collaboration with the FP&A reporting team using tools like Power BI and Anaplan Bachelor's degree in finance or business management. Professional certifications such as CPA, CA, or ACCA are highly recognized. 6+ experience in finance and financial planning & analysis (FP&A) is required, preferably within asset-intensive sectors (such as hospitality, theme parks, sports, or entertainment).

c5560b6430a55923.description: Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments. We are seeking a Senior Design Manager - MEP (Electrical) to join JASARA PMC. The Senior Design Manager – MEP (Electrical) oversees consultant-led electrical and power system design activities across all project stages, ensuring compliance with requirements, approved design briefs, Scopes of Work (SOW), applicable electrical standards, and authority regulations. The role provides technical leadership and design governance for all electrical engineering disciplines, including power distribution, low voltage (LV) systems, medium voltage (MV) interfaces, substations, switchgear, emergency power systems, ELV integration, and smart city infrastructure. The position ensures electrical designs are coordinated with architectural, structural, mechanical, infrastructure, and specialist disciplines to deliver safe, reliable, efficient, and construction-ready solutions. The Senior Design Manager does not undertake detailed design production but is responsible for reviewing, guiding, and assuring the quality, coordination, compliance, and deliverability of consultant design outputs while supporting the Design Director in technical assurance, cost alignment, value engineering, and delivery readiness. Design Leadership & Governance Oversee, coordinate, and monitor all electrical and power system design activities throughout concept, schematic, detailed design, and construction documentation stages. Lead design governance processes related to electrical engineering, including design reviews, technical compliance reviews, change management, and stage-gate approvals. Ensure all electrical designs comply with standards, Saudi Building Code, SEC requirements, IEC standards, NFPA standards, and applicable international best practices. Establish and maintain electrical design standards, specifications, and technical guidelines across the project portfolio. Consultant Management Manage electrical, MEP, and multidisciplinary consultants, ensuring compliance with approved design briefs, SOWs, project requirements, and quality standards. Review and challenge consultant submissions to ensure optimum technical solutions, operational efficiency, maintainability, and lifecycle value. Monitor consultant performance, deliverable quality, programme adherence, and technical compliance. Participate in consultant selection, technical evaluations, and procurement activities. Electrical Systems Oversight Provide technical oversight for the design and integration of: Medium Voltage (MV) Infrastructure Low Voltage (LV) Distribution Systems LV Switchgear and Main Distribution Boards Substations and Electrical Rooms Emergency and Backup Power Systems UPS Systems Generator Systems Earthing and Lightning Protection External Power Networks Street Lighting Systems Smart City Electrical Infrastructure ELV Interfaces and Building Technologies Multidisciplinary Coordination Act as the primary electrical design interface across all disciplines. Ensure electrical requirements are fully integrated with architectural, structural, mechanical, ICT, security, transportation, and utility infrastructure designs. Lead coordination workshops to identify and resolve design clashes, interface risks, and operational concerns. Ensure electrical systems support overall project functionality, resilience, sustainability, and operational objectives. Technical Assurance & Design Review Review engineering calculations, electrical studies, and design reports including: Load Demand Assessments Load Flow Studies Short Circuit Analysis Protection Coordination Studies Arc Flash Studies Power Quality Assessments Reliability and Redundancy Analysis Verify design compliance, constructability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Ensure design solutions support long-term asset management strategies and operational requirements. Cost, Value Engineering & Risk Management Work closely with Development, Commercial, and Cost Management teams to align electrical designs with approved budgets and project objectives. Lead value engineering reviews without compromising safety, performance, reliability, or operational requirements. Identify technical risks, programme impacts, and cost implications and recommend mitigation measures. Support lifecycle cost assessments and whole-life asset value optimization. Construction & Delivery Support Apply strong construction and execution knowledge to ensure electrical design packages are practical, coordinated, and ready for implementation. Support design-to-construction transitions, technical queries, shop drawing reviews, and site coordination activities. Participate in testing, commissioning, and handover readiness reviews. Support Operational Readiness and Transition (ORT) activities. Minimum 15 years of experience in electrical engineering design and project delivery. Minimum 7 years in senior design management or leadership roles. Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering. Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or Engineering Management preferred. Proven experience managing consultant-led design teams on large-scale mixed-use developments, cities, infrastructure, airports, metros, utilities, theme parks, or giga-projects. Extensive experience with power distribution systems, LV/MV infrastructure, substations, switchgear, and critical electrical systems. Experience in Saudi Arabia or GCC mega-project developments preferred

c5f0498e88fa2af6.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a TCC Liaison Officer to ensure seamless coordination between the Transportation Control Centre (TCC) and operational teams during the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) phase of a metro project. This full-time role is critical for maintaining smooth traffic management, timely incident response, and effective communication among all stakeholders involved in metro operations. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The TCC Liaison Officer acts as a primary point of contact, facilitating efficient communication and operational continuity. This role supports the TCC in real-time monitoring, dispatch coordination, and operational decision-making, ensuring that information flows accurately and promptly between control center personnel and field teams. Key Responsibilities Facilitate coordination between the Transportation Control Centre (TCC) and operational teams to ensure efficient traffic management and operational continuity. Act as the primary liaison for incident response, ensuring timely communication and resolution of service disruptions. Support the TCC in real-time monitoring, dispatch coordination, and operational decision-making. Ensure accurate and timely information flow between control center personnel and field teams. Assist in the development and implementation of incident management protocols and response strategies. Collaborate with O&M Contractors, technical teams, and Employer representatives to align operational priorities and ensure compliance with safety and service standards. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Transportation, Traffic Management, or a related discipline. Minimum of 5 years of experience in transportation management systems, preferably within metro or urban rail environments. Experience in metro or railway infrastructure projects. Required Skills Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and coordinate across diverse teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working in high-pressure, real-time operational settings. Familiarity with control center technologies, dispatch systems, and incident tracking tools. Work Environment This role operates within a 24/7 operational environment, requiring flexibility and responsiveness to ensure continuous support for metro operations.

c50a033ade697158.description: About Al Ghurair Al Ghurair is seeking a Financial Services Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on developing and managing the company's automotive financial services ecosystem. The FSM will also ensure strong controls, compliance, and a positive customer experience, while continuously identifying opportunities to strengthen the company’s financing proposition. Coordinate finance applications with partners and resolve issues affecting approval or vehicle delivery. c517c6861666824b.description: Job description We are looking for a talented content creator to produce high-quality marketing videos and develop engaging content for platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and Snapchat. c55569fee66477a8.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking an IT/Telecom Enterprise Architecture Senior Manager to join the Owner's IT and Telecom Infrastructure team. This full-time role involves overseeing the operation, maintenance, performance, and continuous improvement of mission-critical Data Center and Telecom systems for a large-scale project. The position requires strong technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and experience managing complex infrastructure operations within transportation or public infrastructure environments. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee the operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of the Data Center and Telecom infrastructure, ensuring high availability, reliability, and operational excellence. Act as the Owner's representative for all IT and Telecom operational matters, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, project requirements, and industry best practices. Manage, supervise, and provide technical direction to the IT and Telecom Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Contractor, ensuring services are delivered in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Lead a multidisciplinary team of specialists, engineers, inspectors, and technical experts responsible for monitoring and auditing the performance of IT and Telecom assets and associated maintenance activities. Establish and implement performance management frameworks, monitoring tools, KPI dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to measure contractor effectiveness and system performance. Ensure proactive maintenance strategies are implemented to maximize system availability, minimize downtime, and improve asset reliability. Monitor and manage telecom systems, including fiber optic networks, communication infrastructure, WAN/LAN networks, wireless systems, CCTV, passenger information systems, and other operational technologies supporting public transport services. Oversee Data Center operations, including servers, storage systems, virtualization platforms, backup and disaster recovery solutions, and network infrastructure. Ensure compliance with all applicable cybersecurity regulations, standards, and policies within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including risk management, vulnerability assessments, incident response, and security audits. Coordinate with internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and government authorities to ensure seamless operation and integration of IT and Telecom systems. Review and approve maintenance plans, technical reports, operational procedures, and asset management documentation. Identify operational risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity and uninterrupted transport services. Support future technology upgrades, system enhancements, and digital transformation initiatives across the project. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in IT/Telecom infrastructure operations and management. Demonstrated leadership capabilities in managing complex infrastructure operations. Experience within large-scale transportation or public infrastructure environments is required. Strong technical expertise in Data Center and Telecom systems. Required Skills Proficiency in managing IT and Telecom infrastructure, including fiber optic networks, WAN/LAN, wireless systems, CCTV, and passenger information systems. Expertise in Data Center operations, including servers, storage, virtualization, backup, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of cybersecurity regulations, risk management, and incident response. Ability to establish and implement performance management frameworks and monitoring tools. Strong communication and coordination skills for engaging with stakeholders, contractors, and authorities. Work Type This is a full-time position.

c585f9bb60b18483.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a QA Engineer to join its site-based Construction Supervision team in Riyadh. This full-time position is for a major landmark development project that includes the design, enabling, and main works for a large-scale destination, featuring iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. Project Context The project operates under a client governance framework with stringent requirements for program, quality, safety, and sustainability. The Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) is responsible for providing independent, end-to-end supervision and management, ensuring all works are completed, integrated, tested, commissioned, and handed over to support successful operations and long-term legacy objectives. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain the Project Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with Parsons and client requirements. Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with approved quality standards, specifications, and procedures. Conduct quality audits, inspections, and surveillance activities across project sites. Review and approve Quality Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and related quality documentation. Identify, document, and track Non-Conformances (NCRs), Corrective Actions, and Preventive Actions (CAPA). Analyze quality performance trends and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure effective implementation of QA/QC processes by contractors and subcontractors. Prepare quality reports, audit findings, and performance metrics for project management and clients. Support testing, commissioning, handover, and closeout activities to ensure compliance with quality requirements. Provide quality training, guidance, and technical support to project teams. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders on quality-related matters. Ensure compliance with Parsons quality standards, client requirements, and applicable industry codes and regulations. Mentor and support junior quality personnel as required. Perform other duties related to quality assurance and project delivery as assigned. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction, Project Management, Quality Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or a related discipline. Desired Skills and Certifications Certified ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, or ability to obtain certification within 6 months of hire. ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), CMQ/OE, or equivalent certification, or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire. Membership in a recognized Quality organization is preferred. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

c5d1f9db28f77884.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم وتنسيق مبادرات التطوير التنظيمي، بما في ذلك الهياكل الوظيفية، إدارة الأداء، والسياسات، بهدف تعزيز فعالية القوى العاملة والكفاءة التشغيلية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد ومراجعة وتحديث الهياكل والملفات الوظيفية. دعم تحديد الأهداف والتقييمات ووثائق إدارة الأداء. تطوير ومراجعة سياسات وإجراءات وأدلة الموارد البشرية. تنسيق مبادرات الارتباط الوظيفي والثقافة وإدارة التغيير. حفظ سجلات الهياكل والتقييمات ووثائق التطوير التنظيمي. تنفيذ تحليل الوظائف ودعم تخطيط القوى العاملة والتصميم التنظيمي. تنسيق تحليل الاحتياجات التدريبية ومبادرات التطوير. إعداد التقارير والعروض وتحليل مؤشرات فعالية المنظمة. متابعة إنجاز التقييمات والأنشطة مع المديرين. دعم أطر الكفاءات والمسارات المهنية ومشروعات التحسين ومتابعة تقدمها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الموارد البشرية أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنسيق ودعم مبادرات التطوير التنظيمي. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الموارد البشرية في شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

c5e4a4b83a714998.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كارامتارا المتجددة السعودية عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان الالتزام التام بأنظمة ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة (HSE) المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية، وسياسات السلامة الخاصة بالشركة، والمعايير الدولية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطبيق ومتابعة سياسات وإجراءات وتعليمات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وفقًا لمعايير الشركة والأنظمة المحلية. ضمان الالتزام بمتطلبات OSHA وISO 45001 ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة الخاصة بالعملاء. إجراء جولات تفتيش يومية في مواقع العمل لتحديد السلوكيات والممارسات غير الآمنة وظروف العمل غير الآمنة. إجراء تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل سلامة المهام (JSA) قبل بدء الأعمال. الإشراف على متطلبات السلامة أثناء أعمال تصنيع الهياكل الفولاذية والجلفنة واللحام والقطع والدهان والتجميع والتحميل وتصنيع أبراج خطوط نقل الكهرباء. متابعة عمليات الرفع باستخدام الرافعات والرافعات الشوكية والمعدات الثقيلة. تنفيذ برامج التوعية والتعريف بمتطلبات السلامة للموظفين والمقاولين الجدد. تقديم اجتماعات السلامة اليومية (Toolbox Talks) وبرامج التوعية بالسلامة بشكل دوري. التحقيق في الحوادث والحوادث الوشيكة وظروف العمل غير الآمنة، وإعداد تقارير التحقيق. تنظيم تدريبات الإخلاء في حالات الطوارئ والتمارين الوهمية، والتنسيق مع فرق الاستجابة للطوارئ. حفظ سجلات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، وتقارير التفتيش والحوادث، وإعداد التقارير الدورية للإدارة. متابعة مدى التزام المقاولين من الباطن بمتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وتقييم أدائهم. فحص معدات وأدوات الرفع والأدوات الكهربائية والمعدات والآلات وأجهزة السلامة. تقديم التوصيات والمقترحات التي تسهم في تعزيز مستوى السلامة في بيئة العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بأنظمة ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة (HSE) في المملكة العربية السعودية. فهم لمتطلبات OSHA وISO 45001. القدرة على إجراء تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل سلامة المهام. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتدريب والتوعية بالسلامة. القدرة على التحقيق في الحوادث وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية بدوام كامل في منشآت تصنيع خطوط نقل الكهرباء ومواقع المشاريع التابعة لشركة كارامتارا المتجددة السعودية في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف الدور إلى توفير بيئة عمل آمنة والحد من الإصابات والحوادث المهنية ومنع وقوعها. التحسين المستمر يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في دعم تطبيق مبادرات السلامة القائمة على السلوك (BBS) ومساعدة الإدارة في تحقيق أهداف ومؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) الخاصة بالصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشروع. كما يشارك في اجتماعات لجنة الصحة والسلامة والبيئة لتقديم التوصيات والمقترحات التي تعزز مستوى السلامة.

c553d2d450896953.description: The Quality Control Engineer is responsible for inspecting, monitoring, and ensuring the quality of all finishing, interior fit-out, natural stone, and marble installation works in accordance with approved shop drawings, project specifications, material submittals, method statements, and applicable quality standards. The role requires strong technical expertise in architectural finishes, high-end interior fit-out, stone and marble fabrication and installation, ensuring that all works meet the required standards of workmanship, dimensional accuracy, alignment, levelness, joint consistency, surface finish, and overall aesthetic quality. The QC Engineer shall coordinate with site engineers, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and project management teams to identify quality issues, prevent defects, and ensure that all completed works comply with project requirements before handover. Key Responsibilities 1. Finishing and Interior Fit-Out Quality Control Inspect all architectural finishing and interior fit-out activities, including flooring, wall cladding, ceilings, gypsum works, painting, tiling, joinery, doors, decorative finishes, and other interior works. Ensure all executed works comply with approved shop drawings, technical specifications, material approvals, and project quality requirements. Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, verticality, surface flatness, edge details, and finishing quality. Inspect interfaces between different finishing materials to ensure proper coordination, clean transitions, and high-quality workmanship. Conduct site inspections at each stage of work to identify defects before subsequent activities proceed. 2. Stone and Marble Quality Control Perform detailed inspections of natural stone and marble materials, including marble, granite, limestone, travertine, and other decorative stone finishes. Verify material type, color, veining, texture, thickness, dimensions, finish, and overall consistency against approved samples and material submittals. Inspect stone and marble slabs, tiles, and fabricated pieces for cracks, chips, scratches, stains, discoloration, edge damage, and other visual or dimensional defects. Verify slab selection, vein matching, bookmatching, grain direction, color consistency, and layout patterns in accordance with approved drawings and samples. Inspect stone fabrication, cutting, edge profiling, mitre joints, corner details, openings, cut-outs, and polishing quality. Monitor stone and marble installation, ensuring correct setting-out, alignment, levelness, joint width, lippage control, fixing systems, adhesive application, and anchoring methods. Verify substrate preparation, waterproofing where applicable, backing supports, mechanical fixing systems, and installation methods according to approved details and manufacturer recommendations. Inspect grouting, joint filling, sealant application, staining protection, cleaning, polishing, and final finishing. Ensure proper handling, transportation, storage, and protection of stone and marble materials to prevent damage before and after installation.
